summary: ITER171 Critical Platform Stabilization — Backend 10/10 pytest PASS (post-cleanup catalogs verified: 196 dial codes, 7 languages, 16 rooms, 9 chapters; identify anti-enumeration; admin password login returns role=super_admin + is_root_superadmin=true; /api/public/journeys/initiate 3-step accepted; client/resend silent). Frontend P0.3 PASS: /auth/login is STRICTLY password-only (email+password visible immediately, no probe/continue/magic-link toggle), admin login lands on /dashboard with Italian-only concierge copy ('Buongiorno, Stefano', 'Benvenuto nel tuo studio digitale', '07 movimenti'). Frontend /access PASS: single email + 'Continua' CTA, admin → dispatches to /auth/login?email=admin%40moodfordesign.com (password field + prefilled email), fresh client email → 'Controlla la tua casella' (no role/kind/professional/not_found leak). /auth/client/callback?error=otp_expired&error_code=access_denied PASS: URL cleaned via history.replaceState (no error params visible), concierge UI 'Il tuo accesso personale è stato aggiornato' + CTA 'INVIA UN NUOVO ACCESSO'. /begin-journey Step 1 renders ATMOSFERA with all testids (bj-space-*, bj-step1-next).

ui_bugs.issue: React warning persists: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' on /auth/login (and recurs after navigation to /dashboard). Same warning flagged in iter160 — still unresolved.

Many missing editorial_blocks keys still trigger console warnings on /auth/login: auth.login.eyebrow/email_label/email_placeholder/password_label/password_placeholder/cta/hero_image/brand_logo + auth.access.quote/quote_author/need_help/support/support_email + nav.editorial_copy_cms/admin_languages/blueprint_admin. UI falls back to hard-coded IT copy (works) but registry not seeded.

Visible 'EDITORIAL · DEBUG runtime 3 · missing N' badge sits bottom-left of EVERY public page (homepage, /access, /auth/login, /auth/client/callback, /begin-journey, /dashboard) including in production-preview. Likely DevTools overlay that should be gated to non-prod.

3× HTTP 401 console errors right after /access load and right after admin login on /dashboard. Suggests authenticated API calls firing before bearer token is propagated (or unauthenticated probe calls). Not blocking UX but noisy and may mask real auth bugs.

issues: The bottom-left DEBUG badge breaks the cinematic editorial aesthetic and should not be visible on preview/prod URLs.

action_items: Investigate React 'setState during render' warning in LoginPage / AccessEntryPage (recurs across navigation). Likely a setState call inside a render path or a parent–child render cycle (e.g. setting a context value inside a child useEffect-less branch).

Seed missing i18n editorial_blocks keys: auth.login.{eyebrow,email_label,email_placeholder,password_label,password_placeholder,cta,hero_image,brand_logo}, auth.access.{quote,quote_author,need_help,support,support_email}, nav.{editorial_copy_cms,admin_languages,blueprint_admin} in IT locale.
Gate the 'EDITORIAL · DEBUG runtime' overlay to NODE_ENV==='development' (or behind a ?debug flag). It should NOT render on content-hub-pro-22.preview.emergentagent.com.

Root-cause the 3×401 console errors on /access and /dashboard load — either delay auth-protected fetches until token is hydrated or ensure unauthenticated requests don't go to bearer-required endpoints.
critical_code_review_comments: P0.3 strictly enforced — /auth/login has NO email-probe phase, NO 'Continua via email' button, NO magic-link toggle. Just email + password + 'ACCEDI AL WORKSPACE'. Excellent.
P0.2 magic-link error UX is production-grade — history.replaceState cleans URL, concierge copy 'Il tuo accesso personale è stato aggiornato', no raw Supabase 'otp_expired' / 'access_denied' visible.
Anti-enumeration on /api/auth/identify is symmetric (admin → professional/password_exists=true, unknown → client/password_exists=false). No 'not_found' / 'role' / 'kind' leak in /access UI.
Italian-only UI confirmed across all tested pages — no 'login', 'dashboard' SaaS terms visible (header uses 'RIENTRA' + 'IN STUDIO'; dashboard title uses 'studio digitale').
Post-cleanup state verified: only admin@moodfordesign.com present, tenant 848354b9 only, dial_codes=196, languages=7, rooms=16, chapters=9, all green.
Dispatch flow /access → admin properly URL-encodes email as ?email=admin%40moodfordesign.com and prefills the password page. Clean separation between professional and client lanes.

success_rate.frontend: P0.2 100%, P0.3 100% — all critical flows green; only secondary issues (React warning, missing i18n keys, DEBUG overlay, 401 noise) remain

seed_data_creation: Created throwaway journey lead via /api/public/journeys/initiate (iter171client_<timestamp>@example.com) — journey-scoped, additive only, no cleanup needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend post-ITER170 cleanup state is healthy and verified. All P0.2 + P0.3 critical UI flows pass. Remaining issues are all secondary/cosmetic: (1) React 'setState during render' warning on /auth/login (carried over from iter160), (2) ~25 missing i18n keys (fallback IT copy works), (3) DEBUG runtime overlay visible on every page (should be dev-only), (4) 3×401 console errors on /access + /dashboard (auth bootstrap noise). The full 3-step /begin-journey submit-to-magic-link wasn't end-to-end clicked through Step 2/Step 3 in this run, but Step 1 renders all testids (bj-step1-next, bj-space-*) and backend POST /api/public/journeys/initiate accepts the full 3-step payload. PhoneCountryPrefix testids confirmed in earlier iter160: bj-phone-prefix-trigger/menu/option-{IT,US,GB,...}. Main agent can self-verify by clicking through Step 1→2→3 with a fresh email and asserting URL stays /journey/preparing >6s without redirecting.
rca of the issue: No critical bugs to RCA. Carry-over warnings: React setState-in-render almost certainly originates from AccessEntryPage / LoginPage phase machine calling a context/router setter inside render rather than inside a useEffect — inspect the phase-detection useMemo/useState pair. The 3×401s are most likely /api/me, /api/tenant/me, or /api/notifications/unread firing before the JWT cookie/header is hydrated; gate them on auth.isReady.
